data.gender_notes: Osmond is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English osmund, meaning 'wealthy, prosperous'. This name was popular during the Middle Ages, particularly among the nobility. In later periods, it was adopted by various religious orders and saints. The name Osmond carries the meaning “Wealthy, prosperous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Osmond usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Osmond belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealthy, prosperous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Osmond total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Osmond originated from the Old English word 'osmund', meaning 'wealthy, prosperous'. However, its spiritual significance extends beyond its literal meaning. Osmond is a name of hope and divine favor. It evokes images of the blessings of the Lord bestowing prosperity and abundance upon His people. As a Christian name, Osmond embodies the belief that even in material wealth and worldly success, there is a higher spiritual calling to answer to God and serve our fellow man. Additionally, the name's association with saints and religious orders imbues it with a sense of holiness and faithfulness.
